scripts.setup: bun install && cd agent && bun install
scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:agent
scripts.build:demo: bun run typecheck && cross-env VITE_DEMO_MODE=true vite build
scripts.test:coverage:all: bun run test && bun run test:coverage:agent
scripts.dev:local:up: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc up -d --build
scripts.dev:local:down: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc down
scripts.dev:local:restart: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc up -d --force-recreate
scripts.dev:local:rebuild: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc down && docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc up -d
scripts.dev:local:wipe: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc down -v; rm -f data/dev-agent-pubkey.json data/dev-oidc-logins.txt .env.development.local
scripts.dev:local:logs: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc logs -f
scripts.dev:local:logs:worker: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc logs -f worker
scripts.dev:local:logs:db: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc logs -f postgres
scripts.dev:local:logs:agent: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile management --profile oidc logs -f agent
scripts.dev:local:logs:pocketid: docker compose --env-file ~/.config/homelab-manager/.env -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile oidc logs -f pocket-id
